source_paper: Clarke, Smith and Cullingham 2024, Molecular Ecology 33:e17532, DOI 10.1111/mec.17532
source_definition: Original published Figure 3 and figure caption: survival rate, population size, reproductive success. Dataset codes PS / SR / IR crosswalk at the code level; interpret only as endpoints, not evidence that a named ecological function was measured.

PS.next_primary_study_gate: check whether increments are immigrant contributions versus locally produced recruitment

SR.next_primary_study_gate: check whether interaction or physiological mechanism was measured, not assumed

IR.next_primary_study_gate: screen original trait definition, mate/pollinator effects, offspring viability, control, site/cohort alignment

gate_1_decision: Endpoint codebook fixed without reading outcome values. Three IR observations require primary-source protocol review before F_direct admission. No confirmed direct ecological-function outcome from dataset labels alone.
